Studio setup.

Runs a real open model on your GPU using WebLLM. Requires WebGPU and an initial model download (hundreds of MB). No account or key. Model files are cached by your browser.

Runs in a background worker. The first word lookup downloads a small model. Similarity is cosine similarity over a candidate vocabulary, not a probability.

Otherwise, scores use a clearly labeled local language heuristic. The checker is independent of requested strength; it is an estimate, not a guarantee.

Your key stays in localStorage on this browser and is sent only to the endpoint you choose. Exports never include it.

Every completed scrub makes a fresh alternative to the last paragraph. Your previous versions remain in Library. Steering during generation interrupts the unfinished suffix and regenerates it with your updated controls.

The story is the interface.

Select a passage to create an attention box. Its exact text and weight travel with the next generation request. Alt-drag a word upward to pin it, or click a word and choose Pin. Normal dragging selects text. Use the × beside an underlined phrase to remove it.

Open ⊕ Steer to choose tension, pace, tone, focus or resolution. Move the red point: angle chooses the quality, distance chooses strength. Click a collapsed point to edit it. Drag the plus circle backward or forward to choose where the next continuation starts. Your previous version stays in Library when you generate a branch.

Click a word for semantic neighbours and three possible directions. Live engines generate these suggestions. Offline suggestions are labeled lexical estimates.

Rail bars estimate connection to your selected words and recent context. They are not hidden neural attention. Realized scores assess only the newly written paragraph, with the method and explanation available on each label.

No login. Stories and settings stay on this device. Browser AI downloads model files; hosted providers receive your story when selected. Ollama must allow this site's exact origin via OLLAMA_ORIGINS.

Keyboard: Ctrl/⌘ + Enter generates; Escape stops or closes a control. Dials support arrow keys and + / −. Browser-only hosting cannot protect a shared secret; a public shared-key deployment needs a separate secured endpoint.
